title: Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators
abstract: arXiv:2609.05860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. translated_title: 超越任意几何：神经偏微分方程算子的拓扑泛化
translated_abstract: 接受任意网格输入的神经算子通常被视为具有几何通用性，但未见过的域拓扑会同时改变偏微分方程算子的不变子空间和衰减子空间。我们使用霍奇热流作为受控视角来考察这一区别，并引入了TopoBox-3D基准，其中隧道和空腔改变贝蒂数支撑，同时精确的霍奇分解将调和核与正谱分离。在六种架构中，隐式推断拓扑的模型在45个模型-任务拓扑分布外组合中的37个遭受了过度的匹配退化，然而改变调和维度的情形平均而言并未受到更强的惩罚。主要的困难反而是谱方面的：初始瑞利商是误差最稳定的预测指标，而谱展宽为边链和面链增添了信息。最引人注目的是，受控探针实验表明，显式的关联矩阵与调和坐标并不能带来最佳的核一致性准确率……
tldr: 该论文引入TopoBox-3D基准并通过霍奇热流的受控分析，揭示了神经PDE算子拓扑泛化的主要困难来自谱特性（初始瑞利商是最稳定的误差预测指标）而非调和维度变化，且显式拓扑坐标信息并不总是最优方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TopoBox-3D and uses Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens to show that the dominant difficulty in topology generalization for neural PDE operators is spectral—with the initial Rayleigh quotient as the most stable error predictor—rather than harmonic dimension changes, and that explicit incidence and harmonic coordinates do not yield the best performance.
